300W Bi-Colour Video Light — APKINA

A 300W bi-colour video light with app control, a TFT display and six lighting effects.

SPECIFICATIONS
Power: 300W
CRI: Ra ≥95
Colour temperature: 2700–6500K
Intensity: 1–100%
Lighting effects: 6: Flash, Flash Fast, TV, Strobe 1, Strobe 2 and Strobe 3
Power supply: AC 220–240V, 50/60Hz
App control: Supported
Display: TFT
